title: Toward Individual Fairness Without Centralized Data: Selective Counterfactual Consistency for Vertical Federated Learning
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of individual fairness and counterfactual consistency within a vertical federated learning framework. While it discusses algorithmic fairness in terms of protected social attributes (race, age, gender), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethical systems, nor does it apply its framework to LLMs or NLP systems.
